# find pi to the nth digit

> Create a program where you ask the user to enter in the number of digits to calculate PI to. The program then prints PI up to that many digits.

## Solutions

- 级数
    - 格雷戈里-莱布尼茨无穷级数, [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Leibniz_formula_for_%CF%80)
        - `π/4 = 1 - (1/3) + (1/5) - (1/7) + (1/9) - (1/11) + (1/13) - (1/15)....`
        - `π = (4/1) - (4/3) + (4/5) - (4/7) + (4/9) - (4/11) + (4/13) - (4/15) +(4/17)-(4/19)+(4/21)-(4/23)....`
        - 证明: 在泰勒级数取x=1立即得到。
